/docs/: Introduction to Eunoia: a Rust engine for area-proportional Euler and Venn diagrams, with bindings for R, Python, Julia, and JavaScript.
/docs/concepts/complement/: How Eunoia fits a bounding container (the universe) whose leftover area matches a target, for complement-aware Euler diagrams.
/docs/concepts/fitter-pipeline/: Inside Eunoia's spec-to-fit pipeline: MDS initialization, loss-driven refinement, and how ellipses handle lopsided overlaps that circles cannot.
/docs/concepts/glyphs/: How Eunoia packs equally-sized unit glyphs (eulerGlyphs-style dots) inside diagram regions, with uniform or random arrangements and an auto-sized shared radius.
/docs/concepts/goodness-of-fit/: The scalar metrics Eunoia reports (stress, diagError, and residuals) that summarize how faithfully the fitted geometry reproduces the requested region sizes.
/docs/concepts/label-placement/: How Eunoia positions region labels using poles of inaccessibility, keeping text inside the correct area even for complex overlaps.
/docs/concepts/shapes/: The five fittable shapes in Eunoia (circles, ellipses, squares, rectangles, and rotated rectangles), their Venn limits, and when to use each.
/docs/quickstart/javascript/: Generate area-proportional Euler and Venn diagrams in JavaScript with the @jolars/eunoia WebAssembly package.
/docs/quickstart/r/: Generate area-proportional Euler and Venn diagrams in R with eulerr, the original Eunoia binding.
/docs/quickstart/rust/: Generate area-proportional Euler and Venn diagrams in Rust with the eunoia crate, the pure-Rust core behind every binding.
/docs/reference/: API reference index for Eunoia, linking the Rust, R, Python, Julia, and JavaScript binding documentation.
/docs/reference/javascript/: The public API of @jolars/eunoia: exported functions, their options, and return types for the JavaScript and WebAssembly build.
/app/: Interactive area-proportional Euler and Venn diagram builder: enter set sizes and intersections, tune the fit, and export SVG. Runs entirely in your browser.
/docs/cite/: How to cite Eunoia and its language bindings: ready-to-copy BibTeX, BibLaTeX, CSL, APA, Vancouver, and Chicago entries for the Eunoia preprint by Larsson and Lee (2026).
/docs/quickstart/python/: Generate area-proportional Euler and Venn diagrams in Python with the eunoia package.
/docs/quickstart/julia/: Generate area-proportional Euler and Venn diagrams in Julia with the Eunoia.jl binding.
